name: Luka, Inc.

summary.text: Luka, Inc. is the San Francisco company, founded by Eugenia Kuyda, that operates the companion chatbot Replika; its investors include Khosla Ventures and Y Combinator. Italy's data protection authority (Garante) imposed an emergency limitation on Luka's processing of Italian users' data on February 2, 2023 over risks to minors and lack of a legal basis, re-examined the block in June 2023, and on April 10, 2025 fined the company 5 million euros and opened a further inquiry into the generative model behind Replika.

facts.claim: On February 2, 2023 the Garante ordered an urgent provisional limitation on Luka Inc.'s processing of Italian users' data under Article 58(2)(f) GDPR, citing non-compliance with transparency obligations and unlawful processing because minors cannot validly contract.
facts.quote: mancata conformità agli obblighi di trasparenza e trattamento illecito, dato che l'esecuzione del contratto non può fondare il trattamento essendo i minori incapaci di contrarre

facts.claim: On June 22, 2023 the Garante re-examined the block after Luka reported it had cut off access from Italy and barred users under 18, conditioning its decision on further commitments.

facts.claim: By a decision of April 10, 2025, announced May 19, 2025, the Garante fined Luka Inc. 5 million euros, finding that as of February 2, 2023 the company had not identified legal bases for its processing, its privacy policy was inadequate, and its age-verification system remained deficient; it ordered the company to bring its processing into compliance.
facts.quote: alla data del 2 febbraio 2023 la società non aveva individuato le basi giuridiche dei trattamenti, e la privacy policy era inadeguata sotto vari profili

facts.claim: Luka's largest investor is Khosla Ventures and its other investors include Y Combinator, according to a 2022 report; the company is headquartered in San Francisco.
facts.quote: The startup's largest investor is the venture capital firm Khosla Ventures, and other investors include the well-known startup accelerator Y Combinator.

facts.claim: Kuyda has said that building the memorial bot of her late friend Roman Mazurenko at Luka in 2016 led to the idea for Replika, which was released to the public in 2017.
